## What Needs Verification?

- [ ] Factual or vendor/version claim
- [ ] Executable code, CLI options, or dependency
- [ ] External link or license/terms
- [ ] Missing guidance, example, prerequisite, or blank field
- [ ] Unsafe or unapproved execution
- [ ] Navigation, formatting, duplication, or hierarchy

## Evidence & Expected Correction

- **Observed defect / reproducible result:**
- **Official source URL and access date:**
- **Versions / platform / hardware revision:**
- **Proposed minimal correction:**

## Validation & Closeout

- **Status:** Not verified / source verified / static verified / lab verified / blocked
- **Applicable tests and results:**
- **Files that need reciprocal links/updates:**
- **Privacy or authorization constraints:**
- **Reviewer sign-off and commit/PR:**

Do not post real credentials, client data, incident evidence, or private IP inventories. Follow [Repository Verification Protocol](../../Documentation/REPOSITORY-VERIFICATION-PROTOCOL.md).
